changelog: BIM-Bot v2.5.0 — Cross-document annotation transfer (209 MCP tools). New: transfer_annotations copies text notes, tags and dimensions directly between two open, unlinked projects in one step — no linking, no manual focus switching. New: export_annotations / import_annotations move annotations via a neutral JSON transfer file. New: list_open_documents / activate_document let the agent see and switch open documents itself. Text notes transfer exactly; tags re-attach by host UniqueId with a category+level+location fallback; dimensions recreate when references resolve. Every run reports created / skipped / failed with reasons — nothing is silently dropped.
